subject: Finlytics PoC kickoff — access, success criteria, and owners
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@finlytics.io>, Emily Zhao <emily@finlytics.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Finlytics PoC kickoff — access, success criteria, and owners

Hi Oliver / Emily — great to meet this afternoon. Short recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get your PoC running this week. I captured owners and a lightweight timeline below.

Quick summary (5m):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference throughput & latency for Finlytics’ document summarization pipeline and confirm cost-per-doc at your target SLA.
- Success criteria (agreed): 1) <500ms median token latency for 2k doc/day baseline, 2) end-to-end summary quality (ROUGE-1 >= 0.65 on sample set), 3) predictable per-document cost within 15% of estimate.
- PoC scope: 2 dev users, 1 sandbox dataset (5k documents), streaming responses enabled, realtime token-level logs for first 48 hours.

Owners & contacts:
- Redwood PoC lead: Laura Bennett — project owner + external contact
- Engineering/Access: Aditya Rao — will provision API credential, IP allowlist, SSO invites
- CS/Success cadence: Grace O'Connor — weekly syncs and success-metric tracking

Timeline (proposal):
- Day 0 (tomorrow): Share PoC plan + onboarding checklist (attached)
- Day 1: SSO invites + scoped API key + IP allowlist configured
- Day 2–7: Ramp ingestion, run 5k doc pass, capture latency/quality metrics
- Day 8: Review results, decide next steps (expand or iterate)

Immediate asks for Finlytics:
1) Confirm two test users (name + email) for SSO invites
2) Confirm IP ranges we should allow for smoke tests (or say if you prefer VPN)
3) Sign off on the attached PoC plan if any edits are needed

Attachments: finlytics_poc_plan_v1.pdf (PDF) — lightweight plan + checklist; redwood_onboarding_checklist.md (text)

If that looks good I’ll kick Aditya to start the provisioning flow. Happy to jump on a short follow-up demo if you want a live walkthrough.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: finlytics_poc_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.md (text/markdown)]

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@finlytics.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily@finlytics.io>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Finlytics PoC kickoff — access, success criteria, and owners

Thanks Laura — really helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side and a couple of asks before you provision: 

1) Test users: please invite
   - Oliver Grant <oliver@finlytics.io> (Admin)
   - Maya Singh <maya@finlytics.io> (Engineering lead)

2) IP allowlist: our infra team will open a short window for inbound from Redwood. Please confirm the IP prefixes you'll use for the sandbox so we can create firewall rules.

3) API key scope: we prefer a scoped, short-lived API key limited to the PoC dataset and streaming endpoints. Can you confirm token expiry and rotation procedure?

4) Audit/loging: can Redwood surface request-level audit logs and retention window? We need 90-day logs for compliance.

We reviewed the PoC plan attachment and mostly aligned — two tiny edits to the success metrics (I'll inline comments in the Drive doc).

If you can provision SSO + scoped key, we’ll run an initial smoke test and get back with results.

— Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform — Finlytics
oliver@finlytics.io | +1 (617) 555-2244

Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 08:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Finlytics PoC kickoff — access, success criteria, and owners

Hi Oliver — looping in technical details and what I'll provision tomorrow morning.

TL;DR: We will send SSO invites (Okta SAML) within 24 hours, publish the PoC-scoped API key via our secure dashboard with 7-day expiry (you can rotate earlier), and the audit logs are available for 90 days with token-level tracing. IP ranges below.

IP ranges to allow (egress from Redwood to your sandbox):
- 35.192.0.0/12
- 34.80.0.0/12
- (we will announce a short list of egress addresses used for the first 48 hours prior to the test window)

API key details:
- Scope: streaming.generate, model: rdx-large-v1 (PoC), dataset: finlytics-sandbox
- Expiry: default 7 days; we will issue and post key in the secure channel (see link) and also support rotating via our Console
- Delivery: we will send a secured, one-time link (Doc link) for the key to the emails you provided.

Audit logs & retention:
- Request-level logs (request id, model, tokens_in/out, latency) retained for 90 days. We can also provide an export if you want a daily ingest to an S3 bucket (requires the bucket details).

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.md (I’ve updated the network section and added a tiny checklist for smoke tests).

Next steps from me (by Tue morning):
- Create Finlytics PoC org in Console and add Oliver + Maya via Okta SAML
- Issue scoped API key and post secure link
- Send final egress IP addresses for firewall rules

Grace — I’ll hand you the weekly cadence invite once I confirm the calendar window.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@finlytics.io>, Emily Zhao <emily@finlytics.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Finlytics PoC kickoff — access, success criteria, and owners

Perfect — thanks Aditya and Oliver. Confirming the timeline and a couple of admin items:

- SSO invites to Oliver and Maya to be sent today (Okta SAML).
- Scoped API key will be available via secure link by tomorrow AM; note the 7-day expiry, we can extend on request.
- Aditya will publish exact egress IP addresses by EOD so Finlytics can open firewall rules.
- Grace will send a calendar invite for a 30-minute weekly check-in starting next Wednesday (Mar 3).

Oliver — once you receive the key we recommend a single smoke test that hits streaming.generate for 50 short documents (200–500 tokens) to validate connectivity and measure median token latency before you attempt the full 5k ingestion. Please paste any Drive comments and I’ll incorporate the metric tweak you mentioned.

Looking forward — ping me directly if anything blocks provisioning.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
